dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: One distinct, thin white horizontal band is visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against darker gray feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct rectangular white patch is visible on the posterior neck, contrasting sharply with the black crown and greenish mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Large, high-contrast white cheek patch completely surrounded by black plumage.
